facts.fact: Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2) is one of Anthropic's latest models, with a 1M-token context window, 128K max output and a June 2026 training cutoff (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)

Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) has a 1M-token context window, 128K max output and a June 2026 training cutoff, and Anthropic recommends starting with it (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)

Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5) is a latest-generation model with a 1M-token context window, 128K max output and a June 2026 training cutoff (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)

Claude Haiku 5.5 (claude-haiku-5-5) is a latest-generation model with a 1M-token context window, 128K max output and a June 2026 training cutoff (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)
Claude Fable 5.2 list price shown 2026-11-14 was $8/$40 per million input/output tokens (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)
Claude Opus 5.5 list price shown 2026-11-14 was $4/$20 per million input/output tokens (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)
Claude Sonnet 5.5 list price shown 2026-11-14 was $2/$10 per million input/output tokens (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)
Claude Haiku 5.5 list price shown 2026-11-14 was from $0.10/$0.50 per million input/output tokens (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)
Claude cache reads are 10% of base input (2.5% on Fable 5.2/5.1, 5% on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5) as shown 2026-11-14 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)
The Claude Batch API is 50% off as shown 2026-11-14 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)

Every Claude model ID is a pinned snapshot and IDs are dateless from the 4.6 generation on; models before 4.6 use dated IDs (for example claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) with an alias pointing to them (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)

GET /v1/models returns max_input_tokens, max_tokens, a capabilities object (including thinking.types.disabled, server_tools.web_search, server_tools.code_execution) and a line field (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)
The Models API line field was added on 2026-10-01 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)
Current Claude models use adaptive thinking steered by output_config.effort (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)
Manual extended thinking (thinking.type: "enabled" with budget_tokens) is deprecated on Opus 4.6/Sonnet 4.6 and returns a 400 on Claude 4.7 and later (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors)
Fable 5.x, Mythos 5.x and Opus 5.5 reject thinking: {"type": "disabled"} (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors)
Claude Sonnet 5.5 uses thinking: {"type": "between_tools"} as its lowest thinking setting (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors)
Claude Haiku 5.5 accepts thinking type disabled (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors)

Fable 5.2, Mythos 5.2, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 return a 400 for tool_choice any or tool; use auto with strict tool use or structured outputs instead (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors)

Claude structured outputs are stable: JSON outputs use output_config.format with type: "json_schema" and strict tool use uses strict: true on a tool, stable on the Claude API, Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, both Google Cloud offerings and Microsoft Foundry (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/structured-outputs)
Claude structured outputs do not support recursive schemas or numeric/length constraints (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/structured-outputs)

facts.fact: Claude prompt caching default TTL is 5 minutes (write 1.25x base input) with an optional 1-hour TTL ("ttl": "1h", write 2x) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching)

Claude prompt caching allows up to 4 explicit cache_control breakpoints, and the minimum cacheable length is 512 tokens on Opus 5.5/Sonnet 5.5/Haiku 5.5 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching)
Automatic caching via a top-level cache_control field is not available on Bedrock bedrock-runtime (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching)

Claude prompt caches are isolated per workspace on the Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS and Microsoft Foundry, but only per organization on Bedrock and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching)
The Claude Message Batches API is POST /v1/messages/batches and gives 50% off (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/batch-processing)

A Claude message batch holds up to 100,000 requests or 256 MB, expires if not done within 24 hours, and results are downloadable for 29 days (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/batch-processing)

Message Batches support up to 300K output tokens with beta header output-300k-2026-03-24 on supported models (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/batch-processing ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview)
Claude citations return exact supporting passages from documents (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/overview)
search_result content blocks let you supply your own retrieval results so Claude cites them like web search results (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/overview)
The Claude API has no hosted vector store; retrieval is bring-your-own (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/overview)
Claude context editing is beta under context-management-2025-06-27 and clears old tool results and thinking (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta-headers)

Claude threshold compaction is beta under compact-2026-01-12 with edit type compact_20260112 and a default trigger of 150,000 input tokens (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/compaction-threshold)
Claude on-demand compaction entered beta on 2026-09-14 under compact-2026-09-04 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)

Claude message threads entered beta on 2026-11-02 under message-threads-2026-08-12, letting long-running agents send only new messages per request for faster time to first token (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/overview)
The SDK tool runner (client.beta.messages.tool_runner) runs the client tool-use loop (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/overview)
The Claude tool search tool lets Claude load only needed tool definitions (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/overview)
Programmatic tool calling lets Claude call your tools from code inside the code execution container (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/overview)

The Claude web search tool is stable, with versions web_search_20250305 (basic), web_search_20260209 (dynamic filtering) and web_search_20260318 (response inclusion) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-search-tool)
The Claude web search tool is priced at $10 per 1,000 searches plus tokens as shown 2026-11-14 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-search-tool)
Claude web search tool parameters are max_uses, allowed_domains or blocked_domains (not both) and user_location (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-search-tool)

The Claude web fetch tool is stable, with versions web_fetch_20250910, web_fetch_20260209, web_fetch_20260309 (cache bypass) and web_fetch_20260318, and has no extra charge beyond tokens (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-fetch-tool)
The Claude web fetch tool can fetch only URLs that already appeared in the conversation and does not render JavaScript (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-fetch-tool)

The Claude code execution tool is stable with no beta header, with versions code_execution_20250825, code_execution_20260120 (REPL state, programmatic tool calling) and code_execution_20260521 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/code-execution-tool)
Claude code execution containers have 5 GiB RAM, 5 GiB disk, 1 CPU, no internet, and expire 30 days after creation (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/code-execution-tool)

Claude code execution includes 1,550 free hours per organization per month, then $0.05 per container-hour, and is free when used with web_search_20260209/web_fetch_20260209 or later (shown 2026-11-14) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/code-execution-tool)

The Claude memory tool is client-side and stable: declare {"type": "memory_20250818", "name": "memory"} and Claude issues view, create, str_replace, insert, delete and rename commands under /memories that your application executes against storage you control, with no beta header (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/memory-tool)
The Claude memory tool is ZDR eligible (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/memory-tool)

Fable 5.2, Mythos 5.2, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 use computer_toolset_20260801 with no beta header, GA since 2026-08-19 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/computer-use-tool ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)

Older Claude models use computer_20251124 (beta computer-use-2025-11-24), and for computer use you supply the VM or container (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/computer-use-tool)
Computer use is not available in Claude Managed Agents (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/computer-use-tool)

facts.fact: The Claude browser use tool browser_toolset_20260801 launched on 2026-08-19 as a client tool where your application drives a browser (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)
The Python and TypeScript SDKs ship browser and computer use toolset classes (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/overview)
The Claude Files API is GA since 2026-08-19 and needs no beta header (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/files ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)

POST /v1/files accepts files up to 500 MB, 1 TB total per organization, roughly 500 requests per minute, with optional expires_in_seconds from 3,600 to 7,776,000 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/files)
Files uploaded to the Claude Files API are not downloadable; only skill/code-execution outputs are (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/files)

Claude Files and Skills are workspace-scoped, not user-scoped: any API key with access to a workspace can read its files and custom skills; Anthropic recommends one workspace per tenant (default limit 100 workspaces per organization) and never accepting file_id values from end users (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/files ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/skills-guide)
Claude Agent Skills attach via container.skills (type anthropic with IDs pptx, xlsx, docx, pdf, or type custom with skill_... IDs) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/skills-guide)
Claude Agent Skills require the code execution tool (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/skills-guide)
Up to 20 skills are allowed per request, and custom uploads to /v1/skills must include SKILL.md and be under 30 MB (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/skills-guide)
The Claude Skills API left beta on 2026-08-19 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)
Anthropic published the Claude API skill as an open-source Agent Skill on 2026-04-29 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)
Claude Code users can run /claude-api to migrate code to newer models (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-amazon-bedrock)

Claude Managed Agents is in beta: a hosted agent harness built on Agent, Environment, Session and Events concepts, enabled by default for all API accounts (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/overview)
Claude Managed Agents is exposed at /v1/agents, /v1/sessions and /v1/environments, all requiring beta header managed-agents-2026-04-01 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/overview)
Claude Managed Agents is available on the Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/overview)

facts.fact: Claude Managed Agents is available on Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/overview)
Claude Managed Agents is available on the Claude API (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/overview)

Managed Agents built-in tools are bash, read, write, edit, glob, grep, web fetch and web search plus MCP servers; features include memory stores (agent-memory-2026-07-22), vaults, outcomes, multiagent orchestration, webhooks, scheduled deployments, session budgets and self-hosted sandboxes (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/overview ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta-headers)
Claude Managed Agents is not ZDR or HIPAA eligible; sessions are stateful and transcripts persist until deleted (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/overview)
Self-hosted Claude Managed Agents, the only ZDR exception, launched by request on 2026-11-12 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)
MCP tunnels for Managed Agents are a more limited research preview that requires an access request (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/overview)

Dreams (memory reorganization, dreaming-2026-04-21) is a Managed Agents research preview that requires an access request (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/overview ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)

Claude Agent SDK packages are Python claude-agent-sdk (PyPI 0.2.182, Python 3.10+) and TypeScript @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk (npm 0.3.325, Node.js 18.14+) (https://pypi.org/pypi/claude-agent-sdk/json ; https://registry.npmjs.org/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/latest)

The Claude Agent SDK runs the bundled Claude Code binary and exposes query(), ClaudeSDKClient/options (ClaudeAgentOptions) with built-in tools, hooks, subagents, MCP, permissions, sessions, skills and plugins (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/overview ; https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/quickstart)

claude-code-sdk became claude-agent-sdk and @anthropic-ai/claude-code (as SDK) became @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk; ClaudeCodeOptions became ClaudeAgentOptions (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/migration-guide)
Since v0.1.0 the Claude Agent SDK uses a minimal system prompt unless you request the claude_code preset (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/migration-guide)

Third-party products built on the Agent SDK must use API key authentication (or Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry/Claude Platform on AWS via CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY=1, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_ANTHROPIC_AWS=1), not claude.ai login, unless Anthropic has approved it (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/quickstart)

facts.fact: Claude Code 2.1.325 was released 2026-11-13 and is the npm @anthropic-ai/claude-code latest (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/changelog ; https://registry.npmjs.org/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/latest)

Claude Code has 33 hook events (including PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PermissionRequest, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, SubagentStop, SessionStart, SessionEnd, PreCompact) and hook types command, http, mcp_tool, prompt and agent (experimental) (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks)
Claude Code hook exit code 2 blocks on blocking events, and the default timeout is 600 s for command/http/mcp_tool hooks (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks)

Claude Code subagents are Markdown files with YAML frontmatter (name, description required; tools, model optional) in .claude/agents/ or ~/.claude/agents/, or passed as JSON with --agents (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents)

A Claude Code plugin is a directory with .claude-plugin/plugin.json bundling skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers or a hooks module ("mod"), and marketplaces list plugins in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/overview)
Claude Code plugins are managed with /plugin, and Anthropic's official marketplace claude-plugins-official is added on first interactive start (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/overview)

Claude Code skills are SKILL.md instruction packages; a skill saved in ~/.claude/skills/ is available in every project, and project skills live in .claude/skills/ (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/overview ; https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless)

Claude OpenTelemetry tracing has been beta since 2026-10-14: the Claude API can export spans for model requests, tool uses and Managed Agents sessions, and the Anthropic SDKs emit spans for requests and tool-runner calls (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/overview ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)
The Claude Console has a Managed Agents session viewer with per-session usage totals (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/overview)

The Claude API is REST at https://api.anthropic.com, with POST /v1/messages, POST /v1/messages/batches, POST /v1/messages/count_tokens, GET /v1/models, /v1/files and /v1/skills (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview)

Claude API requests send Authorization: Bearer <API key or WIF access token> (or legacy x-api-key), anthropic-version (current 2026-10-21) and content-type: application/json; anthropic-workspace-id is required with an API key that isn't scoped to a workspace (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview)

Claude API version 2026-10-21 was released 2026-10-21; earlier version 2023-06-01 remains, and each SDK major version sends one API version (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/versioning ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/cli-sdks-libraries/overview)

Claude API version 2026-10-21 removes temperature, top_p and top_k (400 on every model), rejects document blocks in assistant messages, and renames several Admin API fields (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/versioning)

Claude API betas are enabled with anthropic-beta: name1,name2 (comma-separated or repeated); endpoint-specific betas are managed-agents-2026-04-01 (/v1/agents, /v1/sessions, /v1/environments), mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22 (/v1/tunnels) and agent-memory-2026-07-22 (/v1/memory_stores) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta-headers)
Google managed reads only one anthropic-beta header, and Bedrock InvokeModel takes betas in the body anthropic_beta array (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta-headers)
Claude API responses carry request-id, anthropic-organization-id and anthropic-workspace-id (added 2026-08-11), plus anthropic-ratelimit-* headers (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview)

Workload Identity Federation for the Claude API launched 2026-05-04, with short-lived access tokens from POST /v1/oauth/token (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)
The Claude Code GitHub Action can use anthropic_federation_rule_id with GitHub OIDC instead of a stored key (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/github-actions)

A 401 beginning CORS requests are not allowed for this Organization means the organization (for example with ZDR) cannot call the API directly from a browser; call from a back end (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors)
The Claude Messages API streams via SSE (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview)
Managed Agents streams session events via SSE at GET /v1/sessions/{id}/events/stream and supports webhooks (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview)
Claude organization webhooks entered beta on 2026-10-20 (webhooks-2026-10-07) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)

The Claude MCP connector is beta: pass mcp_servers (type url, url, name, optional authorization_token) plus a matching {"type": "mcp_toolset", "mcp_server_name": ...} in tools, with beta header mcp-client-2026-09-15 (adds tool-list pinning) or mcp-client-2025-11-20; mcp-client-2025-04-04 is deprecated (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/mcp-connector)

The Claude MCP connector supports only MCP tool calls (no resources or prompts) on servers publicly reachable over Streamable HTTP or SSE (no local stdio) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/mcp-connector)

With the Claude MCP connector the caller must run the OAuth flow and pass the access token; it is not ZDR eligible and is beta on the Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS, Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) and Microsoft Foundry (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/mcp-connector)

Claude MCP tunnels (research preview) are outbound-only tunnels (cloudflared plus an Anthropic proxy, Helm or Docker Compose) that expose private-network MCP servers to the Messages API MCP connector and Managed Agents (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/mcp-tunnels/overview)

Claude MCP tunnels are not available as claude.ai connectors (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/mcp-tunnels/overview)

The Anthropic SDKs include helpers that convert between MCP and Claude API types for running your own MCP client (local servers, prompts, resources) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/overview)

The Claude Platform Docs MCP server com.claude.platform/docs is a remote Streamable HTTP server at https://platform.claude.com/docs/mcp that searches and reads the Claude Platform docs and API reference (https://platform.claude.com/docs/mcp/server-card ; https://platform.claude.com/llms.txt)
The Claude Platform Docs MCP server card is at https://platform.claude.com/docs/mcp/server-card (https://platform.claude.com/docs/mcp/server-card)

Remote MCP servers can be added by URL as custom connectors on Free (one connector), Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise plans (https://claude.com/docs/connectors/custom/remote-mcp ; https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11175166-get-started-with-custom-connectors-using-remote-mcp.md)

Claude connects to custom connectors from Anthropic's cloud, not the user's device (https://claude.com/docs/connectors/custom/remote-mcp)

Claude apps connector authentication options are Claude's published identity (Client ID Metadata Document, recommended), Dynamic Client Registration, or your own OAuth client; static request headers (up to four, beta, limited orgs) suit API-key servers (https://claude.com/docs/connectors/custom/remote-mcp)
A connector URL ending /sse selects the older SSE transport, and connector auth settings cannot be edited after adding (https://claude.com/docs/connectors/custom/remote-mcp)

Claude Desktop installs local MCP servers packaged as .mcpb (MCP Bundles) desktop extensions under Settings > Extensions, and organizations can restrict them (https://claude.com/docs/connectors/custom/remote-mcp)

facts.fact: Anthropic's Connectors Directory lists verified and community MCP connectors, and Anthropic said in December 2025 it held over 75 MCP-powered connectors (https://claude.com/docs/connectors/custom/remote-mcp ; https://www.anthropic.com/news/donating-the-model-context-protocol-and-establishing-of-the-agentic-ai-foundation)

The current MCP specification version is 2026-07-28; prior versions are 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26 and 2024-11-05 (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/latest ; https://modelcontextprotocol.io/llms.txt)

MCP 2026-07-28 is stateless: it removes the initialize handshake and Mcp-Session-Id sessions from Streamable HTTP, adds server/discover, replaces the GET stream and resource subscribe with subscriptions/listen, introduces Multi Round-Trip Requests (InputRequiredResult), removes SSE resumability, and moves tasks to the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/changelog)

MCP 2026-07-28 deprecates Roots, Sampling and Logging, formally deprecates the HTTP+SSE transport (migrate to Streamable HTTP), and deprecates Dynamic Client Registration in favor of Client ID Metadata Documents, with a minimum deprecation window of twelve months (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/changelog)

MCP authorization is based on OAuth 2.1 and is optional; HTTP transports should follow it and stdio should use environment credentials (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization)

MCP servers MUST publish RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata, clients MUST use RFC 8707 resource indicators and PKCE, and clients SHOULD support Client ID Metadata Documents and validate RFC 9207 iss (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/authorization)

Anthropic donated MCP on 2025-12-09 to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF), co-founded by Anthropic, Block and OpenAI; MCP is now "Model Context Protocol a Series of LF Projects, LLC" (https://www.anthropic.com/news/donating-the-model-context-protocol-and-establishing-of-the-agentic-ai-foundation)
The Agentic AI Foundation is a directed fund under the Linux Foundation (https://www.anthropic.com/news/donating-the-model-context-protocol-and-establishing-of-the-agentic-ai-foundation)
MCP is Apache 2.0 licensed, with Lead Maintainers David Soria Parra and Den Delimarsky, and changes go through SEPs (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/community/governance)

One secondary article dates the MCP donation 2026-05-19, but Anthropic's and the MCP blog's primary posts say 2025-12-09, which is the date to use (secondary) (https://businesstechnavigator.com/news/agentic-ai-foundation-mcp-linux-foundation-open-standard ; https://blog.modelcontextprotocol.io/posts/2025-12-09-mcp-joins-agentic-ai-foundation/)
The official MCP Registry is in preview; it stores server.json metadata with reverse-DNS names (io.github.user/server) verified by GitHub, DNS or HTTP (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/registry/about)
The MCP Registry is at https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io and its REST API answers on both /v0/servers and /v0.1/servers (https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers?limit=1)
The MCP Registry is meant for aggregators and does not host private servers (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/registry/about)

The Bedrock bedrock-mantle endpoint for Claude is https://bedrock-mantle.{region}.api.aws/anthropic/v1/messages, and model IDs use the anthropic. prefix (for example anthropic.claude-opus-5-5) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-amazon-bedrock)

Not supported anywhere on Foundry: Admin API, advisor, Managed Agents, Compliance API, Models API, Message Batches, server-side fallback and user profiles; additionally not on Hosted on Azure: code execution, Agent Skills, programmatic tool calling, Files API, and web search/fetch versions after web_search_20250305/web_fetch_20250910 (400 by design) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-microsoft-foundry)

Claude Platform on AWS, launched 2026-05-11, is an Anthropic-operated Claude API at https://aws-external-anthropic.{region}.api.aws/v1/{endpoint} with SigV4 (service aws-external-anthropic) or API keys, billed via AWS Marketplace (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-platform-on-aws ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)
Claude Platform on AWS supports Files, Skills, code execution, batch and Managed Agents (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-platform-on-aws)

Claude Platform on AWS does not support HIPAA, fast mode or MCP tunnels, and requires aws iam enable-outbound-web-identity-federation once per account (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-platform-on-aws)
No Anthropic documentation reviewed describes an A2A endpoint, JDBC/ODBC drivers or GraphQL/SQL APIs for Claude; integration is REST, SDKs and MCP (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview)

Claude Code native install on Windows: PowerShell irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex; CMD curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.cmd -o install.cmd && install.cmd && del install.cmd; no Administrator needed, and native installs auto-update (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup)
winget install Anthropic.ClaudeCode installs Claude Code without auto-update; upgrade with winget upgrade Anthropic.ClaudeCode (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup)

On Windows, Git for Windows is optional: with it the Claude Code Bash tool uses Git Bash (path override CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH), without it Claude Code uses the PowerShell tool; sandboxing works only in WSL 2 (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup)
Claude Code on Windows requires Windows 10 1809+ or Windows Server 2019+ (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup)

Other Claude Code install methods: macOS/Linux/WSL curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash; Homebrew brew install --cask claude-code (stable) or claude-code@latest; signed apt/dnf/apk repos; npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@latest (Node.js 22+, installs the same native binary; never use sudo) (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup)

Sign in to Claude Code by running claude and following the browser login, or claude auth login; claude setup-token mints a one-year CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN for CI; claude doctor diagnoses install and settings; claude update upgrades (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication ; https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup)
Claude Code requires a Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise or Console account, not the free plan (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication)

Claude Code credentials are stored at %USERPROFILE%\.claude\.credentials.json on Windows, ~/.claude/.credentials.json (mode 0600) on Linux and in the macOS Keychain; CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR relocates them (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication)

Claude Code credential precedence: cloud provider env vars, then ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, apiKeyHelper, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, Anthropic profile/WIF credentials, then /login subscription OAuth (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication)

Claude Code settings files are user ~/.claude/settings.json, shared project .claude/settings.json, project-local .claude/settings.local.json, and managed managed-settings.json/MDM/server-managed settings; precedence is managed > --settings > local > project > user, with list keys such as permissions.allow merged (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings)

claude mcp add --transport http <name> <url> (recommended), --transport stdio <name> -- <cmd>, or --transport sse (deprecated) adds MCP servers to Claude Code; OAuth via /mcp or claude mcp login <name> (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp)
Claude Code MCP scopes local (default) and user are stored in ~/.claude.json, and project scope in .mcp.json with ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} expansion (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp)

facts.fact: CLAUDE.md memory locations: managed policy C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\CLAUDE.md (Windows), /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/CLAUDE.md (macOS), /etc/claude-code/CLAUDE.md (Linux); user ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; project ./CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md; personal ./CLAUDE.local.md (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory)
Claude Code can read AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md @path imports go up to four hops (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory)

Claude Code headless mode is claude -p "<prompt>" with --output-format text|json|stream-json, --json-schema, --allowedTools, --permission-mode, --permission-prompts none and --continue/--resume (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless)
claude -p --bare skips hooks, plugins, MCP, CLAUDE.md and OAuth (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) and is recommended for CI (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless)

anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 responds to @claude mentions or runs a prompt; set it up with /install-github-app or manually with secret ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN; GitLab CI/CD is documented separately (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/github-actions)
The Claude Code GitHub Action supports use_bedrock, use_vertex and use_foundry via OIDC (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/github-actions)
The ant CLI for the Claude API is version 2.9.0 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/cli-sdks-libraries/cli/quickstart)

Install the ant CLI on macOS with brew install anthropics/tap/ant, on Linux/WSL from the GitHub release tarball, or with go install github.com/anthropics/anthropic-cli/v2/cmd/ant@latest; profiles are stored in %APPDATA%\Anthropic (Windows) or ~/.config/anthropic (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/cli-sdks-libraries/cli/quickstart ; https://code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication)
ant auth login signs in to the ant CLI (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/cli-sdks-libraries/cli/quickstart)
The ant CLI does not support Bedrock or Google managed (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-amazon-bedrock)
No native Windows installer (winget or MSI) for the ant CLI is documented; Windows users can use go install or WSL (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/cli-sdks-libraries/cli/quickstart)

Instead of IaC, workspaces, API keys, rate limits (Rate Limits API, 2026-04-24) and members are managed through the Admin API (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits)
The Anthropic SDKs expose the Admin API under client.organization, GA since 2026-09-30 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)

facts.fact: Agent SDK demos are at https://github.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-demos, and SDK changelogs are at github.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python and claude-agent-sdk-typescript (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/overview)
Claude Code action examples are at https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code-action/tree/main/examples (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/github-actions)

Claude API usage tiers were consolidated into Start ($500/month cap), Build ($1,000), Scale ($200,000) and Custom on 2026-06-26, and new organizations may start in a lower Evaluation tier (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits ; https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)

Hitting the tier spend cap returns 429 rate_limit_error with error.details.error_code enforced_spend_limit_reached and no retry-after, so retries fail until the next month (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits)

Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 each get RPM/ITPM/OTPM of 4,000/2M/400K (Start), 10,000/5M/1M (Build) and 13,000/10M/2M (Scale); Opus 4.x models share one bucket (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits)
Claude Fable 5.2 rate limits (RPM/ITPM/OTPM) are 4,000/500K/100K (Start), 10,000/1.5M/300K (Build) and 13,000/4M/800K (Scale) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits)

Only uncached input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens count toward ITPM; cache_read_input_tokens do not, and max_tokens does not count toward OTPM (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits)

A sharp usage increase returns 429 with error.details.error_code ramp_limit_exceeded even under the rate limit; wait retry-after and grow by at most one step per minute; Batches are exempt (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits)
Message Batches rate limits are 1,000/2,000/4,000 RPM and 200K/300K/500K queued requests (Start/Build/Scale) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits)
Claude Managed Agents is limited to 300 create RPM and 1,200 read RPM per organization (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits)
The Claude Files API allows about 500 RPM (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/files)
429 rate_limit_error means a rate, ramp or spend limit, while 529 overloaded_error means API-wide overload (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors)
The Anthropic SDKs retry connection errors, 429 and 5xx twice by default with exponential backoff honoring retry-after (max_retries configurable) (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors)

Reaching a spend limit you set returns 400 invalid_request_error ("You have reached your specified API usage limits"), not 429, except the Claude Code workspace, which can return 429 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits)

First-party request size limits are Messages and Token Counting 128 MB, Batches 256 MB, Files 500 MB, Sessions/Agents/Environments 32 MB (413 request_too_large); Claude Platform on AWS, Google Anthropic managed and Foundry allow 32 MB (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview)
Claude requests on Bedrock are limited to 20 MB (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview)

facts.source: Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed)
facts.fact: Claude requests on Google managed are limited to 30 MB (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview)

Use streaming or Batches for Claude requests over 10 minutes; the SDK refuses non-streaming requests expected to exceed a 10-minute timeout and sets TCP keep-alive, and timeout_error (504 or 500) signals a server time limit (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors)
A prefilled final assistant message returns 400 on Claude 4.6 and later; use structured outputs or system instructions (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors)

Thinking blocks must be passed back unchanged: edited or reordered history causes 400 errors about modified thinking blocks or blocks bound to a different conversation; keep history append-only or use thinking-binding-controls-2026-08-01 with prefix_mismatch_behavior: "drop_block" (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors)

Multi-turn requests must send back each web search result's encrypted_content or the API returns 400, and tool errors such as max_uses_exceeded arrive inside a 200 response (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-search-tool)

If web search or web fetch is turned off on the Console Capabilities page, requests including the tool fail with 400 invalid_request_error (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-fetch-tool)

Foundry omits anthropic-ratelimit-* headers; use Azure monitoring and provide both request-id and apim-request-id to support (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-microsoft-foundry)

facts.fact: Claude in Amazon Bedrock defaults to 2M input TPM, raisable to 5M input and 500K output TPM without Anthropic approval, and RPM is enforced by AWS (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-amazon-bedrock)
Bedrock regional endpoints for Claude cost 10% more than global (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-amazon-bedrock)

Claude Code warns above 10,000 tokens of MCP output and caps it at 25,000 by default (MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS); the startup timeout is MCP_TIMEOUT (30 s default in -p) and per-call MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp ; https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless)
Credential variables like ANTHROPIC_API_KEY expand to empty in remote .mcp.json URLs and headers in Claude Code (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp)
Without --bare, claude -p runs project .claude/settings.json hooks and connects .mcp.json servers with no trust dialog, and piped stdin is capped at 10 MB (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/headless)

An approved ANTHROPIC_API_KEY takes precedence over a claude.ai subscription in Claude Code and can cause auth failures if its organization is disabled; unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and check /status (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/authentication)

Commits made with the default GITHUB_TOKEN do not trigger CI, the triggering user needs write access, bots need allowed_bots, and workflows on @beta must move to @v1 (direct_prompt became prompt) (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/github-actions)
Workbench became playground on 2026-08-18 (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview)
Claude Code SDK became Claude Agent SDK (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/migration-guide)
